neighbours.label: words that mark the absence of something (without, lacking, sans, no): the 'without' side of a with / without distinction
fire: The refugees crossed the mountains lacking proper boots or coats.
The village survived the winter lacking electricity for three months.
The album was reissued sans the bonus tracks of the first pressing.
She arrived at the gala sans jewellery, in a plain black dress.
He finished the marathon without water after missing every station.
The cake was made without sugar, so the children refused it.
The prisoners were held for weeks without trial in a remote camp.
The climbers reached the summit with no oxygen in their tanks.
quiet: The refugees crossed the mountains wearing proper boots and coats.
The village survived the winter thanks to a generator for three months.
The album was reissued along with the bonus tracks of the first pressing.
She arrived at the gala wearing jewellery and a plain black dress.
He finished the marathon with water from every station on the route.
The cake was made with extra sugar, so the children loved it.
The prisoners were held for weeks before a trial in a remote court.
The climbers reached the summit with full oxygen tanks on their backs.

predictions: fire 0.2-0.65 on the absence word; the same sentences with 'with' or a positive verb below 0.06
